headword: {職務経歴|しょくむけいれき}

definitions.gloss: work history; employment history; career history
definitions.explanation: A record of the jobs and duties a person has performed over their career, especially as presented when applying for a job.

examples.japanese: {職務経歴|しょくむけいれき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: to write out one's work history

examples.japanese: ⟦{応募|おうぼ}→応募：03014_oubo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{職務経歴|しょくむけいれき}{書|しょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: A work history document is required to apply.

examples.japanese: ⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{職務経歴|しょくむけいれき}⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{詳|くわ}しく→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧⟦{聞|き}かれた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: In the interview I was asked in detail about my work history.

notes:
A person's record of past jobs and responsibilities, central to job hunting. Built from ⟦{職務|しょくむ}→職務：13908_shokumu⟧ (job duties) and ⟦{経歴|けいれき}→経歴：13795_keireki⟧ (career; personal history).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {職務経歴|しょくむけいれき}{書|しょ}: a work-history document (résumé of duties)
- {職務経歴|しょくむけいれき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fill in one's work history

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{履歴書|りれきしょ}→履歴書：04691_rirekisho⟧: résumé; CV — a standard-format personal history form
- ⟦{経歴|けいれき}→経歴：13795_keireki⟧: career; background — broader, not limited to jobs
